_comment: wave 31 (array-of-temporal serializer): the new tgeoseqarray fold (codegen_aggregations.py) accumulates the window as a CONTINUOUS sequence (parseTemporalPoint builder, like tgeoseqtext) then calls a T**-returning accessor f(temp,&_cnt) and brace-joins each element serialized via temporal_as_hexwkb(elem,0x04 EWKB). Two FRESH-token ops that reuse the proven tgeompoint windowed builder (no new builder needed): temporal_segments (generic, exercised on a point sequence) and tpoint_make_simple. Probed green on v15 (wave31_probe.c): a 3-instant continuous sequence yields temporal_segments cnt=1, tpoint_make_simple cnt=1, both valid EWKB hex. The wired per-event temporal_sequences (token conflict) + the 6 trgeometry windowed accessors (need an x/y/theta pose-sequence builder + geo_tpose_to_trgeometry) are the dedicated follow-up.

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_segments (TSequence **) - the array of maximal segments of the windowed continuous trajectory, each as EWKB hex.
tpoint_make_simple (Temporal **) - the array of simple (non-self-intersecting) fragments of the windowed point trajectory, each as EWKB hex.
